title: Current buffer versus selected window

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: Current buffer, selected window, and displayed buffer are separate pieces of state.
hypothesis: `with-current-buffer' should change the current buffer for the dynamic extent without changing the selected window's displayed buffer; `switch-to-buffer' should display the target in the selected window.
minimal_fixture: Two temporary buffers and the initial selected window in batch Emacs.
predicted_behavior: Reading or mutating a hidden buffer with `with-current-buffer' will not display it. Selecting/showing it requires a window operation.
counterexample: Treating `with-current-buffer' as equivalent to user-visible selection loses window history and focus semantics.
derived_gym_requirement: Bridge operations must separate read/operate-in-buffer, display-buffer, and select-for-user actions.
